summary: Fraud involving fake telegraphic transfers totaling Rs.6.7 crore; appellant convicted under IPC s.120B & s.411 for receiving stolen property; circumstantial evidence relied upon; gold bars seized; High Court set aside convictions of two accused but upheld third's conviction; CBI appeal allowed regarding confiscation of gold bars; insufficient evidence to link appellant with Mukesh Shah; conviction based on suspicion not sustainable; gold bars ordered returned to appellant
final_judgment: Appeals allowed for Hiralal Babulal Soni and Vijaya Bank regarding return of gold bars; Nandkumar Babulal Soni's conviction set aside; gold bars restored to appellants.
